source: GitHub (project64/project64 issue #964, 'Pokemon Stadium 2 GB tower bad recompiler performance')
author: purplemarshmallow (a Project64 contributor), comment of 2016-02-18: "Here's my save. It unlocks the speedup feature."
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: The commenter's own game, far enough to unlock the GB Tower speed-up: Please Select shows STADIUM ROUND 2. A 1 Mbit FlashRAM written as 130816 bytes (0x1FF00), word-swapped. Zip entry dated 2016-02-07 14:00.
note: Project64 version not stated; early 2016 means a 2.2/2.3 development build. 130816 is short of the chip's 131072: Project64 writes FlashRAM only as far as the game has written it, here to a 128-byte page boundary. Each 32-bit word is byte-reversed, as in the libretro .srm and MiSTer files: copied unchanged into the FlashRAM region (0x28800) of a Mupen64Plus-Next .srm, the game reads it. proof.png is that check (angrylion), not the author's screenshot. The region is not stated; it loads with the USA ROM.
